item.title: Lorne Gunter: Uncertainty rising with threat of referendum on Alberta separatism
item.description: The provincial government’s search for a major private investor to build a pipeline to the West Coast is reportedly stalled by the uncertainty surrounding a potential separatism referendum this fall.

item.title: Team Canada has three solid defence pairings, but will one of them get benched?

item.title: Opinion: Building infill shouldn't cost Edmonton its trees and gardens
item.description: Walk through one of Edmonton’s older neighbourhoods and you’ll notice the yards feel layered. There are big trees overhead: elms, ashes, old poplars, but there is also something else: lilacs along the fence line, a row of currants tucked beside the garage, maybe a Saskatoon bush that looks like it has always been there. item.title: Baby name dynasty: Olivia and Noah clinch top baby names for Alberta again
item.description: This puts Olivia on a 13-year streak, now having completely left the previous longest-reigning baby name in the dust.

item.title: Edmonton Oilers: What's going wrong and where do they go from here?

item.title: City enlists 100 private graders as foul weather clobbers Edmonton
item.description: The city’s Phase 1 parking ban will come into effect on Wednesday, Feb. 18, at 7 a.m., restricting parking on all major roadways and arterials, collectors and bus runs.
